How is my GPA calculated?

GPA = sum of (quality points × credits) ÷ sum of credits, using grades that count in GPA: 371.8 ÷ 98 = 3.79. Transfer credits are not included. When you pass a course you failed earlier, the passing grade replaces the F in your cumulative GPA, and the transcript keeps both.
